## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the `--exclude` default so CI jobs that set `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` omit the files they configured the tool to skip.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename before writing the archive and logs skipped files at INFO level. It documents the flag and adds parser, collection, and archive tests, along with a review fixture.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` flag, the parser returns an empty exclusion list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions only through the environment still archive matching files.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test exact-name exclusions in nested directories — No test checks `--exclude skip.log` against `nested/skip.log`. The existing wildcard patterns also match full paths, so the tests would pass if the matcher received the path instead of the basename. — A regression to full-path matching could leave nested files in archives despite an exact-name exclusion. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with a nested file and an exact-name pattern.
